pr.title: Keep each inbox item's kind when the band parses one
pr.head: fd56112a500838ae9c4355553b32bed7f200ddcc

summary: The band is the strip above Claude Code's prompt where Projector shows open pull requests and the agent's inbox: the questions and notices that agents post for you. When you answer, dismiss, or snooze an item there, the band runs a project inbox … --json command, and the command prints the changed item. The band's itemOf function reads that printed item and adds the session that the item belongs to, so the band can put it back in its list.

An inbox item is an Item, which is either a Question (kind: 'question') or a Notice (kind: 'notice'). itemOf typed the printed item as Omit<Item, 'session'>. TypeScript's Omit does not apply to each member of a union separately. It merges Question and Notice into one object type whose kind is 'question' | 'notice', and that type is not assignable to Item. So tsc reported error TS2322 in itemOf.

This pull request types the printed item as Omit<Question, 'session'> | Omit<Notice, 'session'>, so each kind keeps its own kind. The change is to types alone. The parsed object, and what the band stores, stay the same at run time.

cards.title: Why the gate missed it
cards.html: No step of the repository's gate type-checks hooks/. claude plugin validate . and claude plugin test . both pass with the error. The Claude Code typings that hooks/ compiles against are written when the engine loads the plugin, so they are not in the repository for CI to use. This pull request leaves the gate as it is.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html: A Projector review of this head found it clean, with no finding threads. It confirmed the TS2322 error at the merge base and its absence at the head with tsc, and ran claude plugin test . (65 pass) and claude plugin validate ..

groups.title: Type the printed item one kind at a time
groups.kicker: How itemOf reads the item that a project inbox command prints
intro: itemOf parses the JSON that a project inbox command prints and returns an Item, a Question or a Notice, with the band's session added. Four functions call it after a command succeeds: settle, deliver, act, and answerFromPrompt. Each passes the result to replace, which swaps the item into the band's list.
The new Printed type lists the two kinds separately, so spreading the parsed item and adding session yields a Question or a Notice, which TypeScript accepts as an Item.

files.note: Adds the Printed type and uses it in itemOf. The import of Notice is the only other change.

checks.text: The comment above Printed says why the type has two Omits. Without it, the type looks like it could fold back into one Omit<Item, 'session'>, which brings the error back.

With tsc 5.9.3 over hooks/, the merge base reports register.tsx(281,60): error TS2322 in itemOf, and this head reports no error there. The typings available to the review were older than the ones the plugin loads against, so both commits also show the same set of unrelated errors.
The as assertion is erased when TypeScript compiles the file, so itemOf returns the same object at run time as before. claude plugin test . ends 65 pass and 0 fail at this head.
